### Added
- **The connectivity chart ships the PriorityClass the gpu-node-pool chart's prewarm placeholder runs at** (giantswarm/agent-platform#539). A pool created with `prewarm: true` launches its first node with the release: the pool chart's one-shot placeholder Job holds one GPU at negative priority until the first predictor preempts it. A `PriorityClass` is cluster-scoped, and a pool release is delivered under Flux multi-tenancy as the organisation's tenant ServiceAccount, whose rights are namespaced — a pool chart that rendered the class failed `InstallFailed` on it and the pool never came up. The connectivity chart now renders `PriorityClass agent-platform-prewarm-placeholder` — `value: -1000` (below the default priority 0, so any workload preempts the placeholder), `preemptionPolicy: Never`, `globalDefault: false`, the `cluster-manager` component label, a description naming its use — from `clusterManager.prewarmPriorityClass` (`enabled: true`, `name`, `value`), mirrored in the meta chart; the pool chart's `pool.prewarm.priorityClassName` defaults to the name and renders no class of its own (giantswarm/gpu-node-pool#15). The class renders **with the cluster-manager component**, which composes the pool releases and is on in exactly one release per installation (the platform's) — not with the model-serving switch, which on an installation is on in the serving slice cluster-manager creates beside the pool: a class gated there would arrive after the pool's Job and leave with the slice. `enabled: false` renders none (a placeholder pod naming a class the cluster lacks is rejected at admission; the pool itself comes up without a prewarmed node); `value` is immutable on the API, so a change is a rename. Guards fail the render naming the key on a value at or above 0 or fractional, a name that is not a DNS-1123 subdomain, and the reserved `system-` prefix. `tests/verify-mirrored-values.py` holds the block equal between the charts (a forwarded copy under another name would rename the class every pool expects), with a negative control in `make verify-meta`; `make verify-cluster-manager` asserts the class, its knobs, the guards and that nothing renders while the component is off. README: "The prewarm placeholder's PriorityClass".
